# Deck3 Media Routing & Fail-Closed Image QA — V1

## Physical-illustration first law — media routing (2026-10-13)

Read `DECK3_REAL_WORLD_REFERENCE_FIRST_LAW_V1.md` before rendering physical equipment. The **first candidate medium** for relevant equipment is authentic, inspected real-world imagery, used in a unified diagram/scene where permission, topology and slide purpose allow. Otherwise produce original, reference-grounded equipment imagery and report that no actual photo was embedded. Overlay exact electrical/thermal/control semantics in controlled native/vector elements. This priority does not force photos into research workflows, citations, equations, source matrices or numerical plots. Do not certify based solely on image quality, search results or SVG syntax.

## Deck3 all-forms v2 learning contract (2026-10-09)
For every Deck3 text-in-chat, Stage 1 PPTX, one-slide edit, AI scientific figure, mechanism diagram, engineering framework, mathematical visualization, Stage 3 assembly, animation, export and QA, apply `.github/skills/deck3/references/DECK3_ALL_FORMS_WEAKNESS_LEARNING_V2.md` and corrected Dossiya Research Expert `.github/skills/dossiya-research-expert/references/DECK3_WEAKNESS_TO_VERIFIED_LEARNING_V2.md`. The two old Deck3 learning V1 protocols remain historical and are superseded for active work. Use the actual A13/B13/C13 feature mapping. **Do not equate frozen objectives with validated physics; preserve research scope.** For physical slides, prefer one unified scientifically plausible real-equipment AI scene + scientifically meaningful clearly directed arrows + minimal exact on-scene labels; use native editable labels/ports/equations when possible. Do not turn science into unrelated abstract boxes, invented outputs or embedded literature-card panels. Apply gates G01–G15, falsification cases A01–A20, source/citation review and stage-specific tests; record NOT_RUN rather than PASS for unperformed verification.

**Status:** ACTIVE workflow correction and figure-production authority; subordinate to current canonical thesis scientific authorities, the primary global-update contract, exact palette, mechanism-trace standard, AI-image standard, and the absolute `DECK3_NO_EXPLANATORY_PANELS_IN_IMAGES_V1.md` rule.

## Why this is needed

The 2026-10-09 Chapter 1 audit found a **correct 13-slide Stage-1 text-only baseline** but **ten AI 1672×941 PNGs** dominated by text-box taxonomies, embedded evidence notes/matrices, objective and method cards, and a chapter roadmap. The ten are raster-only, none has an independently editable same-stem SVG or a registered `*.trace.json`. These outputs must not be called Stage-2-approved or assembled as certified science. Rendered attractiveness, white backgrounds and labels are insufficient.

## Rule: choose the MEDIUM before the rendering tool

Each slide must have a *purpose-qualified media plan*, not a default of `image_gen` for every figure slot:

1. **Physical equipment or spatial/thermal engineering scene:** original scientific image/vector allowed, when actual recognizable components add mechanistic comprehension. Show relevant system boundaries, physical devices, scientifically meaningful ports/flows/quantities with short minimal **on-scene** labels only; external heat as external forcing. Use AI image generation only when a rendered image meets the required output properties, then separately review exact mechanisms and science.
2. **Directed evidence-gated cross-system physical mechanism:** prefer **one integrated recognizable real-equipment scene plus a scientifically precise mechanism diagram** where equipment depiction improves understanding, with individually **native editable** evidence qualifiers, ports, equations and critical arrow labels; use native-only diagrams when equipment imagery adds no scientific value, but never embed evidence-gate prose bands or unverified equations in the image. A candidate P→T_e relationship and a candidate T_e→P relationship are distinct assertions; T_e→P needs an independently reviewed grid-side AC measurement/constraint.
3. **Research/literature matrix, assumptions, comparison, research questions/objectives, model-method workflow, contributions mapping, schedule/roadmap:** create **native editable PPTX shapes, charts, tables or text** unless the user explicitly requests a separately authored static scientific diagram or image. Do **not** render a slide-within-a-slide as an AI PNG.
4. **Mathematical result, equation or time evolution:** use editable Office Math/PPTX shapes/actual plotted data and provenance; never generate results, values, thresholds or citations as image content.
5. **Frozen objectives and title:** preserve exact canonical strings in editable text, normally no dominant illustration. Frozen-objective text is a documented visual-share exception.
6. **Scientific source/citation:** attached same-slide editable text/notes with confirmed source; never place fabricated author-year strings inside AI-rendered imagery.
7. **If no appropriate scientific visual exists:** keep the content genuinely text-led and report `NO_FIGURE_SCIENTIFICALLY_JUSTIFIED`; do not fill 75% with decorative boxes to game occupancy.

## Acceptance gates, fail closed

A slide/figure may be marked **PROVISIONAL** after image creation. To become `STAGE2_FIGURE_APPROVED_FOR_ASSEMBLY`, require:
- `S`: claim and physics/source review, correct system membership and directional effect status;
- `H`: visual review at intended slide size: **NO explanatory panels, mini-tables, bottom bands, text-card dominance, copied figures or unreadable details**; components, labeled interfaces and clear arrows where relevant;
- `C`: verify exact 13-token authored colors from *source*; raster-only pixels are not color-certified from palette proximity;
- `M`: same-stem mechanism trace sidecar for physical arrows, checked structurally and reviewed for meaning/provenance; no autogenerated causal proof;
- `I`: legible 70–80% **meaningful figure content** share when a figure is actually justified (not its PNG bounding box); native text, figures, notes, citations survive assembly, with meaningful exceptions for text-led slides;
- `A`: independent editable objects and presenter `On Click` groups when required; playing an image in PowerPoint does NOT animate its internal components;
- `Q`: actual PPTX render inspection and presentation playback where claimed.

Automated filename/hash/dimensions/SVG syntax checks only pass **ASSET INTEGRITY**. They can never independently claim figure science, no-explanatory-panel compliance or certified PowerPoint animation. Manual review required where tool cannot objectively inspect semantics. If no review, label `STAGE2_PROVISIONAL_NOT_CERTIFIED`, not PASS.

## Evidence-based remediation of ten 2026-10-09 AI drafts

Keep the generated 10 PNGs as **rejected or provisional visual exploration**, not approved assets. Slide-specific actions follow table above. In particular:
- Slides **6, 10, 11, 12, 13** contain or function as large text-heavy panels and must be rebuilt natively for the main deck.
- Slides **3 and 9** are dominated by labeled membership boxes rather than physical equipment. Replace only if a meaningful original physical-system illustration is needed.
- Slides **4 and 5** have useful conceptual structures but need appropriate equipment/state semantics, shorter labels and native evidence qualifiers; **Slide 7** should be native semantic alignment.
- Any paper title/authors in generated images require independent source verification before reuse.
- AI PNGs cannot be promised infinite resolution on zoom; preserve separate SVG/vector source and editable PPTX components for scalable/native designs.

## Relation to older required 'three points' manifest fields

The manifest's `message` and `bullets` are hidden authoring fields, **not** literal audience headings. A slide may retain the approved substantive one-statement/three-support structure. No image should repeat that content as a screenshot, table or mini-slide. Any proposed departure from the currently frozen approved wording/three-point baseline is a **separate editorial revision**, not an implicit consequence of new figure production.

## Mandatory audit record

Before approval, record for each slide: `slide`, `medium`, `figure_required`, `evidence_status`, `figure_source_kind`, `object_and_arrow_register_status`, `source_citations_checked`, `no_explanatory_panels_manual_review`, `palette_source_review`, `native_editability`, `effective_occupancy_review`, `animation_playback_review`, `release`, `limitations`.

**Working-status terms**: `TEXT_ONLY_SOURCE_READY`, `IMAGE_PROVISIONAL`, `NATIVE_EDITABLE_VISUAL_PENDING`, `STAGE2_FIGURE_APPROVED_FOR_ASSEMBLY`, `STAGE3_RENDERED_PROVISIONAL`, `RELEASE_CERTIFIED_ONLY_WHEN_ALL_NEEDED_GATES_PASS`.

Avoid silently rewriting old PPTX or old citations. Rebuild in a new versioned working folder with documented checks.
